There could be a number of reasons why a car may have difficulty starting. Some common causes include a dead battery, a faulty starter motor, issues with the ignition system, or a problem with the fuel system. It could also be caused by a lack of maintenance, such as old spark plugs or a dirty air filter. To diagnose the issue and find a solution, it may be necessary to take the car to a mechanic for further inspection and testing.

Suzuki Mehran is a city car produced by Pakistan Suzuki Motors. It is based on the Suzuki Fronte and is a rebadged version of the original Maruti 800 that was sold in India, with minor changes to the exterior and interior. It was first introduced in Pakistan in 1989, and it has been in production ever since. It is powered by a small 0.8-liter engine, and it is available in both manual and automatic transmissions.

Mehran is considered as one of the most popular cars in Pakistan due to its fuel efficiency, low cost, and reliability. However, it has faced criticism for its lack of safety features and poor build quality. Despite that, it has remained popular among the lower-income groups of the country, who could not afford to buy a new car. In 2020, Pakistan Suzuki Motor Company discontinue the production of Suzuki Mehran.


Maruti 800 is a compact city car that was produced by the Indian automaker Maruti Suzuki from 1983 to 2014. It was one of the first models introduced by the company and quickly became popular in India due to its fuel efficiency, low cost, and reliability. It was based on the Suzuki Fronte and powered by a small 0.8-liter engine. The car was available in both a 2-door and 4-door configuration and was available with both manual and automatic transmissions. Despite being discontinued in 2014, Maruti 800 is still considered as one of the iconic cars in India, known for its fuel efficiency, reliability, and low maintenance cost.
